title: Voruna/Prime
extract:
Release Date: April 8th, 2026
 Voruna Prime is the Primed variant of  Voruna, sporting increased Armor, Energy, and Sprint Speed, as well as an additional  polarity. Voruna Prime was released alongside  Perigale Prime and  Sarofang Prime.

Acquisition

Crafting

Notes
 Voruna Prime, compared to  Voruna:
Higher Armor (265 vs. 200)
Higher Energy (130/180 vs. 100/150)
Higher Starting Energy (75 vs. 50)
Higher Sprint Speed (1.2 vs 0.95)
Additional  polarity ( vs. )
If Voruna Prime wields her Signature Weapons:
 Perigale/ Perigale Prime: Gains 24 more Ammo Maximum, for a total of 48/56.
 Sarofang/ Sarofang Prime: Heavy Attack Slam vortex requirement reduced to 5x Combo Multiplier.
Dynar Prime and Raksh Prime are both labeled Voruna Prime Armor in Voruna Prime's Appearance Shoulder Pad Attachments which can be swapped out for other armors. This is purely cosmetic and removing them does not affect Voruna's usage on her abilities.

Trivia
Voruna Prime is the 50th Prime Warframe released, parallel to  Styanax being the 50th base Warframe.
Voruna Prime was revealed in Devstream 194.
Voruna Prime's trailer was the first Warframe trailer to not only be marked NSFW (Not Safe For Work) on social media and in the in-game news section, but to also be prefaced with a mature content warning when originally aired, due to its intense gore.
As a result, public ads and shorts of the trailer omitted any gruesome scenes in the trailer, including the blood splatter on the Lotus/Tenno symbol at the end of the video.
The ending of her trailer, showing her holding Viktor's severed head and still-attached spine as a trophy, references the Mortal Kombat franchise, specifically Sub-Zero's "Spine Rip" Fatality. The shot of her holding it aloft references the Predator franchise.
Voruna Prime runs on all fours during  Ulfrun's Descent. This trait is not present in her original, non-primed variant.
This makes her the second Prime Warframe to receive altered animations from their base counterpart, the first being  Titania Prime's floating animations while walking.
Voruna Prime is the second Prime Warframe whose component blueprints do not drop as a common Void Relic reward, instead being two uncommon and two rare. All past Prime Warframes except  Vauban Prime had at least one common blueprint with two uncommon or rare ones, although all of Vauban's blueprints were rare on his initial release.
Voruna Prime's helmet has an articulated jaw and a mouth that can open and close. This is only seen in her trailer, with her in-game helmet being completely static.
Voruna Prime's wolves lose most of their identifying features from their base appearances:
Dynar Prime is attached to her left shoulder and no longer has an eyepatch, instead having large handle-like 'arcs' between his jaw and ears and a wavy horn.
Raksh Prime is attached to her right shoulder and instead of straps on his lower jaw, he has oversized lower canines and two smaller ridges along the crown of his head instead of a singular horn.
Lycath Prime is attached to her left hip and instead of a pointed nose with a nose ring, he has entirely metallic jaws/teeth resembling a shark with a prominent point at the tip of his snout.
Ulfrun Prime is attached to her right hip and keeps his oversized upper canines, as well as a prominent horn along the crown of his head and metallic ears.
Despite her wolves changing in appearance between base and Prime form, the artwork used for Voruna's passive still shows them in their base forms.
